user.title: Connect to Nexview
user.description: Needs Nexview {min_version} or newer. Create the key in Nexview under your profile, in Access keys.

data_description.url: Where Nexview answers, for example http://nexview.local:8000
data_description.api_key: A personal access key starting with nxv_. What this integration can show and do follows the account the key belongs to, and a key marked read only will show figures but decide nothing.

reauth_confirm.title: Nexview rejected the key
reauth_confirm.description: {name} needs a new access key. The old one was revoked, expired, or belongs to an account that is no longer active.

data_description.api_key: The new key has to belong to the same Nexview account as before.

reconfigure.title: Change how Nexview is reached
reconfigure.description: Point {name} at a different address, or store a new key. The key has to belong to the same Nexview account as before - a different account belongs in an entry of its own.

data_description.api_key: Paste the key again, or a new one. It is not shown here.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from that address. Check that Nexview is running and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: Nexview rejected the key. It may have been revoked or expired.
error.not_a_key: That is not an access key. Nexview keys start with nxv_ and are created in your profile under Access keys, not with your password.
error.too_old: This Nexview is too old for the integration. It needs {min_version} or newer.
error.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different Nexview account. Use a key from the same account, or add a second entry instead.
error.unknown: Nexview answered with something unexpected. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Nexview account is already connected.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Nexview is reachable under the new settings.

approve_request.name: Approve request
approve_request.description: Approves a waiting request, exactly as pressing approve in Nexview would.

request_id.name: Request
request_id.description: The number of the request. Notifications carry it, and the list action returns it.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

reject_request.name: Reject request
reject_request.description: Rejects a waiting request. The person who asked is told.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown to the person who asked. Leave empty to reject without one.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

defer_request.name: Defer request
defer_request.description: Puts a request aside without deciding it. It stays visible in Nexview.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

cancel_request.name: Cancel request
cancel_request.description: Cancels a request that is already running.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

search.name: Search
search.description: Looks a title up in TMDB and answers with what it found. Changes nothing - use the result to decide what to request.

media_type.name: Kind
media_type.description: Movie or series. Movies if not given.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

list_requests.name: List requests
list_requests.description: Answers with the requests and what became of them. Carries the request number that the deciding actions need.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only requests in this state, for example pending_approval, downloaded or rejected. All of them if left empty.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

active_downloads.name: Active downloads
active_downloads.description: Answers with what is being fetched right now, including how far along each one is.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

get_quota.name: Get allowances
get_quota.description: Answers with what each account has used of its allowances, for titles and for storage. Both always apply in Nexview, and either one being full stops a request.

account_id.name: Account
account_id.description: One account by its number. All of them if left empty.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

now_playing.name: What is playing
now_playing.description: Answers with what is being watched right now on the connected media servers, including who, on which device, and whether the server is converting. Deliberately an action rather than a sensor: this says who watched what, and that does not belong in a database that keeps everything for years.

config_entry_id.name: Nexview
config_entry_id.description: Which Nexview, if more than one is connected.

no_entry.message: No Nexview is connected, or the entry is not loaded.

ambiguous_entry.message: More than one Nexview is connected. Name which one this action means.

may_not_decide.message: The key used for {name} may not decide requests. Use a key from an account that can approve, and make sure it is not marked read only.

unknown_request.message: There is no request {request_id} in Nexview. It may have been decided or removed already.

unknown_instance.message: Nexview does not know an instance called {instance}.

push_missing.title: Nexview cannot reach Home Assistant
push_missing.description:
{name} is connected and its figures are up to date, but Nexview cannot call back. Events therefore arrive late or not at all, and Home Assistant asks every 30 seconds instead.

Nexview has to be able to reach {url}. Usually this means Nexview sits on a different network than this Home Assistant, or a firewall is in between.

If that is how it has to stay, turn the callback off in this integration's options and this notice will go away.

push_too_old.title: This Nexview cannot notify Home Assistant yet
push_too_old.description: {name} is connected and its figures are up to date, but callback addresses arrived in Nexview 0.31. Events therefore only appear when Home Assistant asks, every 30 seconds.\n\nUpdate Nexview, or switch the callback off in the integration options to stop this notice.

init.title: Which accounts get their own entities
init.description: By default Nexview shows only the totals for the house. Pick accounts here to get their allowances as entities of their own. Each account adds seven, so a large installation is better off picking a few.

data.push: Let Nexview notify this Home Assistant

data_description.push: Nexview calls this Home Assistant the moment something happens, instead of being asked every 30 seconds. Turn it off if Nexview cannot reach this address - the figures keep working either way.

abort.no_accounts_visible: This key cannot see other accounts, so there is nothing to pick.
abort.cannot_connect: Nexview did not answer. Try again in a moment.
